value.en: Prognostication reads: "Striking Hairy Head foretells unrest among the northern peoples".
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Encroaching on Hairy Head means the northern tribes are unsettled".

value.zh: 二年六月，鮮卑阿妙兒等寇西方，燉煌太守王延斬之，并二千餘級。
value.en: In the sixth month of year two the Xianbei under Amiao'er raided the west; Dunhuang administrator Wang Yan killed them, taking more than two thousand heads.
value.literal: " Year 2, sixth month: the Xianbei led by Amiao'er and others raided the west; Wang Yan, Administrator of Dunhuang, beheaded them, more than two thousand heads in all.

value.zh: 三年，又斬鮮卑大帥及千餘級。
value.en: In year three another Xianbei chieftain was killed, with more than a thousand heads taken.
value.literal: Year 3: the Xianbei great chief was again beheaded, with more than a thousand heads.

value.zh: 正始元年十月乙酉，彗星見西方，在尾，長三丈，拂牽牛，犯太白。
value.en: Zhengshi 1, tenth month, day yiyou: a comet appeared in the west at Tail, three zhang long, sweeping Lead Ox and crossing Venus.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 1, tenth month, day yiyou: a comet appeared in the west, in Tail, three zhang long, brushing Lead Ox and encroaching on Great White.

value.zh: 十一月甲子，進犯羽林。
value.en: Eleventh month, day jiazi: it advanced to strike Feathered Forest.
value.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: it advanced to encroach on Feathered Forest.

value.zh: 占曰：「尾為燕，又為吳，牛亦吳、越之分。
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Tail governs Yan and also Wu; Lead Ox marks Wu and Yue as well.
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Tail governs Yan and also Wu; Ox is likewise the allotted field of Wu and Yue.

value.zh: 太白為上將，羽林中軍兵。
value.en: Venus is the commander-in-chief; Feathered Forest is the central host.
value.literal: Great White is the great general; Feathered Forest is the central army.

value.zh: 吳、越有兵喪，中軍兵動。」
value.en: Wu and Yue face war and mourning; the central army mobilizes."
value.literal: Wu and Yue have warfare and mourning; the central army stirs."

value.zh: 二年五月，吳將全琮寇芍陂，朱然圍樊城，諸葛瑾入沮中。
value.en: In the fifth month of year two Wu general Quan Cong attacked Quebei; Zhu Ran besieged Fancheng; and Zhuge Jin entered Juzhong.
value.literal: " Year 2, fifth month: Wu general Quan Cong raided Quebei; Zhu Ran besieged Fancheng; Zhuge Jin entered Juzhong.

value.zh: 吳太子登卒。
value.en: Wu crown prince Deng died.
value.literal: Wu heir apparent Deng died.

value.zh: 六月，司馬懿討諸葛恪於皖，恪焚積聚，棄城走。
value.en: In the sixth month Sima Yi attacked Zhuge Ke at Wan; Ke burned his supplies and fled the city.
value.literal: Sixth month: Sima Yi attacked Zhuge Ke at Wan; Ke burned his stores and abandoned the city in flight.

value.zh: 三年，太尉滿寵薨。
value.en: In year three Grand Commandant Man Chong died.
value.literal: Year 3: Grand Commandant Man Chong died.

value.zh: 袁躍 裴敬憲 盧觀 封肅 邢臧 裴伯茂 邢昕 溫子昇
value.en: Yuan Yue, Pei Jingxian, Lu Guan, Feng Su, Xing Cang, Pei Bomao, Xing Xin, and Wen Zisheng
value.literal: Yuan Yue, Pei Jingxian, Lu Guan, Feng Su, Xing Cang, Pei Bomao, Xing Xin, Wen Zisheng

value.zh: 正光末，廣陽王淵為東北道行臺，召為郎中，軍國文翰皆出其手。
value.en: At the end of Zhengguang, Prince Yuan of Guangyang served as Northeast Circuit Commander and summoned Zisheng as Gentleman; all military and state papers came from his hand.
value.literal: At the end of Zhengguang, Prince Yuan of Guangyang served as Northeast Circuit Commander; he summoned Zisheng as Gentleman; all military and state documents issued from his hand.

value.zh: 於是才名轉盛。
value.en: His fame for talent then grew still greater.
value.literal: Thereupon his fame for talent grew still greater.

value.zh: 黃門郎徐紇受四方表啟，答之敏速，於淵獨沉思曰：「彼有溫郎中，才藻可畏。」
value.en: Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Xu Hong received memorials from the four quarters and answered them swiftly; facing Yuan alone he mused and said, "They have Gentleman Wen on staff—his literary power inspires dread."
value.literal: Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Xu Hong received memorials from the four directions and answered swiftly; facing Yuan alone he pondered and said: "They have Gentleman Wen there—his literary talent is formidable."

value.zh: 高車破走，珍實盈滿，子昇取絹四十匹。
value.en: When the Gaoche were routed, booty filled the tents; Zisheng took forty bolts of silk.
value.literal: When the Gaoche were routed and fled, treasures filled the camp; Zisheng took forty bolts of silk.

value.zh: 及淵為葛榮所害，子昇亦見羈執。
value.en: When Yuan was slain by Ge Rong, Zisheng too was seized and detained.
value.literal: When Yuan was killed by Ge Rong, Zisheng was also seized and held.

value.zh: 榮下都督和洛興與子昇舊識，以數十騎潛送子昇，得達冀州。
value.en: Heluo Xing, a subordinate commander under Rong and an old acquaintance of Zisheng, secretly escorted him with several dozen horsemen until he reached Jizhou.
value.literal: Ge Rong's subordinate commander Heluo Xing was an old acquaintance of Zisheng; with several dozen horsemen he secretly sent Zisheng off, enabling him to reach Jizhou.

value.zh: 還京，李楷執其手曰：「卿今得免，足使夷甫慚德。」
value.en: On returning to the capital, Li Kai grasped his hand and said, "You have come through alive—enough to make Yifu blush for his character."
value.literal: Returning to the capital, Li Kai took his hand and said: "You have now escaped—enough to make Yifu ashamed of his virtue."

value.zh: 自是無復宦情，閉門讀書，厲精不已。
value.en: From then on he lost all desire for office, shut his door to read, and honed his mind without cease.
value.literal: From then on he had no further desire for office, shut his door and read books, and refined his mind without cease.

value.zh: 白裴崔韋二李皇甫王
value.en: Bai, Pei, Cui, Wei, the two Lis, Huangfu, and Wang
value.literal: Bai, Pei, Cui, Wei, two Li's, Huangfu, Wang

value.zh: 王播，字明敭，其先太原人。
value.en: Wang Bo, styled Mingyang, came from a Taiyuan family.
value.literal: Wang Bo, styled Mingyang, his ancestors were men of Taiyuan.

value.zh: 父恕為揚州倉曹參軍，遂家焉。
value.en: His father Shu served as grain-store aide in Yang Prefecture, and the family settled there.
value.literal: His father Shu served as grain-store aide of Yangzhou, and there the family settled.

value.zh: 播，貞元中與弟炎、起皆有名，並擢進士，而播、起舉賢良方正異等。
value.en: During the Zhenyuan era Bo, together with his younger brothers Yan and Qi, all won renown; all three passed the jinshi examination, and Bo and Qi were also selected in the exceptional grade of the Worthy and Upright examination.
value.literal: Bo, in the Zhenyuan era, together with his younger brothers Yan and Qi all had fame; all passed the jinshi examination, and Bo and Qi were also raised in the exceptional grade of Worthy and Upright.

value.zh: 補盩厔尉。
value.en: He was appointed magistrate of Zhouzhi County.
value.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Zhouzhi.

value.zh: 以善治獄，御史中丞李汶薦為監察御史。
value.en: Because he was skilled at handling legal cases, Censor-in-Chief Li Wen recommended him for appointment as investigating censor.
value.literal: Because he was skilled at handling cases, the censor-in-chief Li Wen recommended him as investigating censor.

value.zh: 雲陽丞源咸季坐賕免，賂有司復得調，播劾解其官。
value.en: Yuan Xianji, assistant magistrate of Yunyang, had been dismissed for bribery but bribed the relevant offices and secured a new appointment; Bo impeached him and had him removed from office.
value.literal: The assistant magistrate of Yunyang, Yuan Xianji, was removed from office for bribery, bribed the relevant offices and again obtained reassignment, and Bo impeached him and stripped him of his post.

value.zh: 歷侍御史。
value.en: He later served as attendant censor.
value.literal: He served successively as attendant censor.

value.zh: 李實為京兆尹，與播遇諸衢。
value.en: Li Shi was serving as intendant of the capital district when he encountered Bo in the street.
value.literal: Li Shi was Jingzhao intendant, and he met Bo in the streets.

value.zh: 故事，尹當避道揖，實不肯。
value.en: By precedent the intendant was supposed to yield the road and bow, but Shi refused.
value.literal: By precedent the intendant should yield the road and bow, but Shi would not.

value.zh: 播移文詆之。
value.en: Bo sent an official dispatch denouncing him.
value.literal: Bo sent a dispatch denouncing him.

value.zh: 實大怒，表播為三原令，將折之，播受命，趨府謝如禮。
value.en: Shi flew into a rage and had Bo transferred to the post of magistrate of Sanyuan, intending to humiliate him; Bo accepted the appointment and promptly went to the intendant's office to pay his respects according to protocol.
value.literal: Shi was greatly angered, memorialized to appoint Bo magistrate of Sanyuan intending to break him, Bo accepted the order, and hurried to the office to pay thanks according to ritual.

value.zh: 邑中豪強犯法，未嘗輒貸，歲終課最。
value.en: He never readily pardoned powerful local offenders, and at year's end his performance ranked first.
value.literal: When powerful men in the district violated the law, he never readily pardoned them, and at year's end his assessment ranked highest.

value.zh: 實重其才，更薦之，德宗將擢以要近，會母喪解。
value.en: Shi came to respect his ability and recommended him again; Emperor Dezong was about to promote him to an important post at court when the death of his mother forced him to leave office.
value.literal: Shi valued his talent and recommended him again; Dezong was about to promote him to an important nearby post when his mother's death obliged him to resign.

value.zh: 還，除駕部員外郎。
value.en: When he returned to service he was appointed outer-office member of the Directorate of Imperial Carriages.
value.literal: When he returned he was appointed outer-office member of the Directorate of Imperial Carriages.

value.zh: 長安令于頔奴客與民盜馬，吏系民而縱奴，播捕取，均其罰。
value.en: A slave-guest of Yu Di, magistrate of Chang'an, and a commoner stole horses together; officials detained the commoner but let the slave go free, so Bo arrested both and imposed equal penalties.
value.literal: The magistrate of Chang'an, Yu Di's slave-guest and a commoner stole horses; officials detained the commoner but released the slave, and Bo seized and punished both, equalizing their penalties.

value.zh: 遷工部郎中，知御史雜事。
value.en: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Works and put in charge of miscellaneous censorial affairs.
value.literal: He was transferred to director of the Ministry of Works and given charge of miscellaneous censorial affairs.

value.zh: 刺舉不阿，有能稱。
value.en: In investigation and impeachment he never bent to favor, and he won a reputation for ability.
value.literal: In investigation and impeachment he did not bend, and he had a reputation for ability.

value.zh: 關中饑，諸鎮或閉糴，播以為言，三輔不乏。
value.en: When Guanzhong suffered famine and some garrison commands hoarded grain by closing sales, Bo protested, and the Three Adjuncts did not go wanting.
value.literal: Guanzhong suffered famine; some garrison commands closed grain sales, Bo spoke out against this, and the Three Adjuncts did not lack provisions.

value.zh: 歷虢州刺史。

value.en: Earlier, Yingda had joined Yan Shigu, Sima Caizhang, Wang Gong, and Wang Yan in compiling more than one hundred chapters of exegesis on the Five Classics under the title Yizan; an edict renamed the work Zhengyi.
value.literal: At first Yingda together with Yan Shigu, Sima Caizhang, Wang Gong, and Wang Yan received orders to compile exegesis on the Five Classics totaling more than one hundred chapters, titled Yizan; an edict changed it to Zhengyi.

value.zh: 雖包貫異家為詳博，然其中不能無謬冗，博士馬嘉運駁正其失，至相譏詆。
value.en: Although the work embraced many schools and was exhaustive, it could not avoid error and redundancy; Erudite Ma Jiayun attacked its mistakes, and the two sides exchanged ridicule and slander.
value.literal: Though it encompassed divergent schools and was detailed and broad, within it there could not but be errors and redundancy; Erudite Ma Jiayun refuted and corrected its faults, to the point of mutual ridicule and slander.

value.zh: 有詔更令裁定，功未就。
value.en: An edict ordered another round of revision, but the task was never finished.
value.literal: An edict again ordered it to be examined and fixed; the work was not completed.

value.zh: 永徽二年，詔中書門下與國子三館博士、弘文館學士考正之，於是尚書左僕射於誌寧、右僕射張行成、侍中高季輔就加增損，書始布下。
value.en: In the second year of Yonghui, the Secretariat and Chancellery, together with erudites of the three academies and Hongwen academicians, reviewed the text. Left Vice Minister Yu Zhining, Right Vice Minister Zhang Xingcheng, and Attendant Gao Jifu then revised it further, and the book was finally issued.
value.literal: In the second year of Yonghui, the Secretariat and Chancellery together with erudites of the three academies of the Directorate of Education and academicians of the Hongwen Hall examined and corrected it; thereupon Left Pushe Yu Zhining, Right Pushe Zhang Xingcheng, and Attendant Gao Jifu added and subtracted, and the book was finally promulgated.
